title: KHTp
description: Adds Teleport to the game, Admins can configure, Server Side Only, Works with Geyser
body:
## Adds Teleport to the game.
### Commands
#### Admin:
- /tep admin town set # (1 is the default and you do not need to put 1)(set as many as you like)
- /tep admin pull <Player> (Brings player to you)
- /tep admin goto <Player> 
- /tep admin cooldown <seconds> (restricts players from spamming teleport 0=disabled)
- /tep admin whileInjured <enable/disable> (Makes it so players must have max health in order to teleport. If mod reduces max health it should still work.)
#### Player:
- /tep town # (1 is the default and you do not need to put 1)
- /tep home
- /tep home set
- /tep base
- /tep base set
- /tep req (sends a request, asking to teleport to the reciever.)
- /tep inv (sends an invite to the reciever asking them to come to sender.)

#### Notes:
I chose /tep over /tp or /khtp because I want server owners to be able to use it without it looking branded but also it doesn't conflict with the vanilla /tp.


#### Future Ideas:
- Add more to config options for admins
- Allow people to people to set more than just numbers for towns
